paper.title_en: The validity of the universal relation between corrections to entropy and the extremality of Schwarzschild-de Sitter black holes under the GUP and EUP
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the extremality relations by examining perturbative corrections to both the entropy of Schwarzschild-de Sitter black holes and their extremality bounds under the Nariai limit within the frame of the generalized uncertainty principle (GUP) and the extended uncertainty principle (EUP) respectively. The GUP-corrected or EUP-corrected horizons bring about the additional terms finally in the Goon-Penco relation to violate the universal ones and these extra terms cannot be canceled by adding the adequate conditions. We argue that the corrected uncertainty principles including GUP and EUP violate the validity of extremality relations because no matching condition can be imposed to support the Goon-Penco relation unless the influences from GUP and EUP disappear.
